proposals.name: Operating Millage Renewal Proposition for Veterans
proposals.description: Shall the limitations on the amount of taxes which shall be assessed against all property both real and personal in Alpena County, Michigan be continued as provided in Section 6, Article IX of the Michigan Constitution, and the Alpena County Board of Commissioners be authorized to levy a tax not to exceed 0.21 (21/100) mill ($0.21 on each $1,000.00 of Equalized State Taxable Value) for a period of four (4) years starting with the levy made December 1, 2026 for the purpose of providing funds to…
proposals.ballotLanguage: Shall the limitations on the amount of taxes which shall be assessed against all property both real and personal in Alpena County, Michigan be continued as provided in Section 6, Article IX of the Michigan Constitution, and the Alpena County Board of Commissioners be authorized to levy a tax not to exceed 0.21 (21/100) mill ($0.21 on each $1,000.00 of Equalized State Taxable Value) for a period of four (4) years starting with the levy made December 1, 2026 for the purpose of providing funds to equip, operate, maintain and provide support and assistance services to Veterans through the Alpena County Department of Veterans Affairs (the estimate of revenue the County of Alpena will collect if the millage is approved and levied in the first year (2026) is ($274,291.27).
proposals.officialTitle: Operating Millage Renewal Proposition for Veterans
proposals.yesVote: A YES vote continues the existing levy of 0.21 mills for 4 years — generally no increase over what you pay now.
proposals.noVote: A NO vote lets the current millage expire; the service it funds would need cuts or other revenue.
proposals.conservativeView: Renewals are the least disruptive way to keep a service funded, but every renewal is a chance to ask whether the service is delivering value. Watch for "renewal" proposals that quietly restore Headlee rollbacks — that is a tax increase.
proposals.progressiveView: Keeps an existing, voter-approved service funded at the same rate with no new tax.

The purpose of this proposal is to authorize such funds to be used for other governmental purposes.
Shall the County of Alpena, State of Michigan, be authorized to use $20,452.65, which constitutes…

Shall the currently authorized millage rate limitation of 1.2872 mills ($1.2872 on each $1,000 of taxable valuation) on the amount of taxes which may be assessed against all property in Alpena-Montmorency-Alcona Educational Service District, Michigan, to provide funds for the education of students with a disability, be renewed for a period of 10 years, 2027 to 2036, inclusive; the estimate of the revenue the intermediate school district will collect if the millage is approved and levied in 2027 is approximately $3,536,404 from local property taxes authorized herein (this is a renewal of millage that will expire with the 2026 tax levy)?
proposals.officialTitle: ALPENA-MONTMORENCY-ALCONA EDUCATIONAL SERVICE DISTRICT SPECIAL EDUCATION MILLAGE RENEWAL PROPOSAL
proposals.yesVote: A YES vote continues the existing levy of 1.2872 mills for 10 years — generally no increase over what you pay now.
proposals.noVote: A NO vote lets the current millage expire; the service it funds would need cuts or other revenue.
proposals.conservativeView: Renewals are the least disruptive way to keep a service funded, but every renewal is a chance to ask whether the service is delivering value. Watch for "renewal" proposals that quietly restore Headlee rollbacks — that is a tax increase.
proposals.progressiveView: Keeps an existing, voter-approved service funded at the same rate with no new tax.

proposals.ballotLanguage:
The voters previously approved a millage for the purpose of funding the acquisition, construction and equipping of health care facilities by Alpena General Hospital. The County no longer operates Alpena General Hospital but continues to hold approximately $20,000 in taxes levied for such purposes. The purpose of this proposal is to authorize such funds to be used for other governmental purposes.
Shall the County of Alpena, State of Michigan, be authorized to use $20,452.65, which constitutes taxes levied for the acquisition, construction and equipping of health care facilities by Alpena General Hospital, for any governmental purpose?
proposals.officialTitle: Hospital Millage Reallocation Proposal
proposals.yesVote: A YES vote approves a new levy of the levy described in the ballot language — this is a tax increase.
proposals.noVote: A NO vote rejects the new tax; your property tax rate stays where it is.
proposals.conservativeView: This is new taxation. Ask whether the need could be met within existing budgets, whether the millage sunsets, and who oversees how the money is spent.
proposals.progressiveView: New funding dedicated to a specific local service that supporters say current revenue cannot cover.
